english.title: Distribute article infringing copyright
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), in the course of a business, namely **(..SPECIFY BUSINESS..), and without the licence of the copyright owner, distributed an article, namely **(..SPECIFY ARTICLE..), which was and which you knew or had reason to believe was an infringing copy of a copyright work
english.legislation: Contrary to section 107(1)(d)(iv) and (4) of the Copyright, Designs and Patents Act 1988.

investigatoraction.description: Criminal lifestyle offence under Schedule 2 to POCA - consider confiscation order

DNA Samples: If crime scene stain present - take evidential sample If no crime scene stain and DNA not confirmed on PNC - take Criminal Justice sample. If DNA confirmed on PNC - CJ sample not required
Confirm proposed charge is appropriately authorised (Police or CPS)
Ensure compliance with investigator's obligations re disclosure
Consider if case suitable for referral to Financial Investigation Unit and CPS for asset recovery eg confiscation order

english.notes:
(i) In relation to any offence of making/selling counterfeit tapes/compact disc's/records of music, films or games, or the infringing of trade marks, the police service may wish to obtain expert advice and assistance in their investigations from the British Phonographic Industry Anti-Piracy Unit.
(ii) In any enquiry relating to the manufacture or distribution of pirate films, including via the Internet, you can contact FACT (Federation Against Copyright Theft) for assistance and advice.
(iii) The penalty on indictment was increased by section 1(2) of the Copyright, etc. and Trade Marks (Offences and Enforcement) Act 2002 as from 20/11/2002.

other.penalty:
SUMMARY: Six months imprisonment and / or a fine not exceeding the statutory maximum.
INDICTMENT: Ten years imprisonment and / or a fine.

Time limit for prosecutions:
None

On the 12th March 2015 the limit on fines imposed by a Magistrates' court was removed – as such, the potential fine on summary conviction in relation to an offence committed after this date is unlimited.
